knowledge_points.givens: Three nonparallel vectors drawn on an equal square grid and an expression target=lambda*first+mu*second.
work: Construct or mentally choose a two-leg path to the target
Match each coefficient to its corresponding basis vector
knowledge_points.endpoint: Return both scalar factors, as a pair choice or two numeric fields.
knowledge_points.unsupported_support: An auxiliary decomposition path or labeled scalar multiples would supply the central decisions.

knowledge_points.givens: Two known position vectors from common O, a point dividing their endpoint segment in a stated ordered ratio, and the requested position vector to that point.
work: Interpret ordered ratio AX:XB as fraction AX/AB=m/(m+n)
knowledge_points.endpoint: Express requested O-to-interior-point vector in known vectors, with full expression or two coefficient fields.
knowledge_points.unsupported_support: Supplying either complementary coefficient or the total-parts/fraction calculation removes required ratio interpretation.

knowledge_points.givens: Three vectors on uniform grid and target expression containing one known multiple and one unknown multiple. The unknown can multiply a or b; known multiple can be fractional.
work: Identify which reference vector has the known coefficient
Construct its scaled vector from the origin
Infer the residual parallel to the other vector
Count its relative length and match scalar
knowledge_points.unsupported_support: A drawn residual path or supplied residual ratio removes the construction/counting work.
